meta_title: Lady Gardener Waterside | Landscape Gardener Southampton
meta_description: Lady Gardener Waterside brings creative garden design and expert landscaping to Southampton. Bespoke outdoor spaces tailored to you. Call for a free consultation.
hero_eyebrow: Award-Winning Garden Design — Local to Southampton
hero_subhead: Tired of an overgrown garden or bland patio? We design and build beautiful landscapes that work for your life, not against it.
services_heading: Complete Landscape & Garden Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From initial design concept through to finished planting and hard landscaping, we handle every aspect of creating your dream garden.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke designs tailored to your style, budget, and lifestyle. We'll sketch your vision in 3D and walk through it with you before any work begins.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Professionally laid patios, decking, and raised beds that last. We source quality materials and ensure proper drainage and foundations.

services.title: Planting & Landscaping
services.desc: Expert plant selection and arrangement for year-round colour and texture. We choose species suited to Southampton's climate and your garden's sunlight.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Soil Prep
services.desc: Complete garden overhaul, from overgrown jungle to clean slate. We remove waste responsibly and prepare soil rich with nutrients for new planting.

services.title: Boundary Fencing & Screens
services.desc: New fences, trellis, and living screens to add privacy and shelter. We install durable timber and composite fencing built to withstand coastal weather.

services.title: Garden Maintenance Plans
services.desc: Monthly or seasonal care to keep your garden looking its best year-round. Pruning, weeding, feeding, and seasonal tidying on a schedule that suits you.

about_pullquote: I garden because it matters — a good space changes how people live.
about_para_1: Lady Gardener Waterside was founded on a simple belief: your garden should reflect who you are and work with your lifestyle, not against it. With nearly two decades of landscape design and build experience across the South Coast, I've transformed over 500 gardens — from small urban courtyards to sprawling country plots. Every project starts with listening to what you actually want, not imposing trends.
about_para_2: Customers return to us because we deliver exactly what we promise, on time and on budget. We source our own plants and materials, which means better quality and genuine value. Whether you want a low-maintenance contemporary space, a wildlife-friendly haven, or a vibrant cottage garden, we have the expertise and local knowledge to make it happen.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a completely neglected back garden — trees overgrown, nothing but weeds. Claire listened to what we wanted, drew up a beautiful design, and transformed it in three weeks. The planting scheme is gorgeous and she's even given us a simple maintenance plan so we can keep it looking great. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Brilliant experience from start to finish. Free consultation, clear pricing, no surprises. She knew exactly which plants would thrive in our shady corner and the new deck is rock solid. Would absolutely recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Our front garden was a nightmare of gravel and dying shrubs. Claire redesigned it completely — it's now a proper showcase for the house. She source plants locally too, which I really appreciated. Friendly, professional, and genuinely cares about getting it right.
reviews.author: Rachel H.
